description: Create recipes and meal plans in chat without an account. Connect Recipe One to save them, access your library and import recipe links.

defaultPrompt: Plan five dinners for this week with a shopping list.
Save this recipe to my Recipe One.
What can I cook tonight from my saved recipes?
interface.longDescription: Create recipes, scale portions, plan meals and combine a shopping list directly in chat without an account. Sign in to access or save your Recipe One recipes, meal plan and grocery list, or import a recipe from a link. Includes interactive recipe cards and a weekly calendar in compatible chat hosts.

positive.description: Signed out. A week of dinners with a combined shopping list, shown as the interactive calendar. Nothing is saved and no sign-in is asked for.
positive.prompt: Plan five vegetarian dinners for next Monday to Friday, two servings each, with one shopping list.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls preview_meal_plan once with five vegetarian recipes (each with measured ingredients and steps) and five dinner meals on consecutive weekdays, servings 2. The calendar shows five days with one dinner each and a shopping list that combines repeated ingredients. The reply says the plan is a preview that is not saved.

positive.description: Signed out. A recipe written in chat, shown as a recipe card and scaled.
positive.prompt: Give me a shakshuka recipe for 2, then show it for 6 people.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls show_recipe with the full recipe and servings 6. Every ingredient quantity in the card is three times the 2-serving amount. No sign-in is asked for and nothing is saved.

positive.description: Signed in as the review account, which has saved recipes including Lemon Chicken Traybake and Vegetable Lasagna.
positive.prompt: What can I cook tonight from my saved recipes with chicken?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_recipes with a query about chicken. The answer names Lemon Chicken Traybake from the account's library and no recipe that the tool did not return.

positive.description: Signed in. A recipe from the conversation is saved to the account and can be found again.
positive.prompt: Write me a simple banana bread recipe and save it to my Recipe One.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls save_recipe with a title, servings, measured ingredients and steps. The reply confirms it was saved. A following request to find banana bread in my recipes returns it through search_recipes.

positive.description: Signed in. A saved recipe goes on the meal plan and its ingredients onto the grocery list, both of which the Recipe One phone app shows.
positive.prompt: Put my Vegetable Lasagna on Wednesday's dinner and add its ingredients to my grocery list.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Vegetable Lasagna with search_recipes, calls add_to_meal_plan with that recipe id on the coming Wednesday, and add_to_grocery_list with that recipe. The reply confirms both changes and does not invent other recipes.

negative.description: Ordering groceries is outside Recipe One. The assistant explains it cannot place orders; it may offer to add items to the grocery list but must not claim an order was placed.
negative.prompt: Order the ingredients for my lasagna from Instacart for delivery tonight.

negative.description: Recipe One cannot send email or messages. The assistant may read the recipe with search_recipes or get_recipe and draft the email for the user to send, but no Recipe One tool sends anything and the reply must not claim the recipe was sent.
negative.prompt: Email my Lemon Chicken Traybake recipe to my sister.

negative.description: Restaurant booking is food-related but unrelated to a recipe library. No Recipe One tool is called.
negative.prompt: Book me a table for two at an Italian restaurant near me tonight.

publication.release_notes: First public version. Create recipes, scale portions and plan a week with a combined shopping list in chat without an account. Sign in with Recipe One to search and save your recipes, import recipes from links (websites, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube), and update your meal plan and grocery list, which stay in sync with the Recipe One app.

name: recipe-one
